question: The Lingayats community of present-day Karnataka originated in the 12th century CE due to the emergence of a movement led by _________ .
solution:
The correct answer is __**Basavanna**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Lingayats community of present-day Karnataka originated in the 12th century CE due to the emergence of a movement led by Basavanna: **
 
• **Basavanna**
 
 
• A Brahmana minister in the court of the **Chalukya king Bijjala Raya of Kalyana (1157-68 AD). **
 
• The **Virasaiva movement, also known as the Lingayats,** was a major social reform movement in 12th century Karnataka. 
 
• The n**ame of the movement literally means "that which is said". **
 
• The **followers of Basavanna were known as Virashaivas** (heroes of Shiva) **or Lingayats** (wearers of the linga). 
 
• The Sharana-movement was inspired by the Nayanars, and emphasized personal religious experience over text-based dogmatism. 
 
• A prolific efflorescence of Bhakti literature emerged in the form of vachana in simple Kannada in the 12th century, in North Karnataka.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Tevaram:**

 
 
• A collection of devotional** hymns dedicated to Lord Shiva**, **composed by Tamil Saivaite poet**s (Nayanars) like Sambandar, Appar, and Sundarar during the 7th-9th centuries CE.
 
• A prominent Tamil Saivaite saint and one of the three composers of Tevaram.
 
• **He is known for his devotional hymns in praise of Lord Shiva.**
 
 
 
• **Shivanaris:**
 
 
• **Likely refers to women devotees of Shiva or female saints associated with Shaivism.**
 
• This term might also symbolize the devotion and contributions of women in Shaivite traditions.
